using Random
using Base64

n = parse(Int, readline())

if n < 2
    println("None")
else
    rng = Random.Xoshiro(0)
    points = [rand(rng, 2) for _ in 1:n]
    min_dist = Inf
    closest_pair = Tuple{Tuple{Float64, Float64}, Tuple{Float64, Float64}}()

    for i in 1:n-1
        for j in i+1:n
            dx = points[i][1] - points[j][1]
            dy = points[i][2] - points[j][2]
            dist = sqrt(dx^2 + dy^2)
            if dist < min_dist
                min_dist = dist
                closest_pair = ((points[i][1], points[i][2]), (points[j][1], points[j][2]))
            end
        end
    end

    println("($(closest_pair[1][1]), $(closest_pair[1][2])), ($(closest_pair[2][1]), $(closest_pair[2][2])))")
end

using Random
using Base64
using CairoMakie

n = parse(Int, readline())

if n < 2
    println("None")
else
    Random.seed!(0)
    points = [rand() for _ in 1:n]
    min_dist = Inf
    closest_pair = Tuple{Tuple{Float64, Float64}, Tuple{Float64, Float64}}()

    for i in 1:n-1
        for j in i+1:n
            dist = sqrt((points[i][1] - points[j][1])^2 + (points[i][2] - points[j][2])^2)
            if dist < min_dist
                min_dist = dist
                closest_pair = ((points[i][1], points[i][2]), (points[j][1], points[j][2]))
            end
        end
    end

    println("($(closest_pair[1][1]), $(closest_pair[1][2])), ($(closest_pair[2][1]), $(closest_pair[2][2])))")
end
